text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Wicksteed Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Vaughan Street and Wicksteed Avenue. The traffic control signals will provide enhanced safety for all road users and is justified based on the assessment undertaken.
City Council on October 9 and 10, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Vaughan Street and Wicksteed Avenue.
